p: consider diligently what is before thee: Eat with sobriety.
And put a knife to thy: Bridle your appetite, as if by force and violence.
for they are deceitful food: For often the rich when they bid their inferiors to their tables, it is not for the love they bear them, but for their own secret purposes.
wisdom: Bestow not the gifts that God has given you, to get worldly riches.
evil eye: That is, covetous, as contrary a good eye is taken for liberal as in Pr 22:9.
morsel which thou hast eaten shalt: He will not cease till he has done you some harm, and his flattering words will come to no use.
and thy expectation shall not be: The prosperity of the wicked will not continue.
way: In the observation of God's commandments.
the truth: Spare no cost for truths sake, neither depart from it for any gain.
thy heart: Give yourself wholly to wisdom.
and increaseth the transgressors among men: She seduces many and causes them to offend God.
to seek mixed wine: Who by art make wine stronger and more pleasant.
eyes shall behold strange women: That is, drunkenness will bring you to whoredom.
sea: In such great danger will you be.
seek it yet again: Though drunkenness makes them more insensible then beasts, yet they can not refrain.
